content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm unable to establish a connection between my PC and [product_name] using [product_name] [version_no]. When I enter the [product_name] address into the tools-options-interface, it's not recognized and the status stays as 'NO'. Automatic detection doesn't work either. I notice Rx/Tx lights flashing, and the local connection sends but doesn't receive anything. Any suggestions? Best regards, [user_name]

Hi, Is the PC's IP address in the same range as the [product_name]? Only the last three digits should differ. For example: [product_name] 10.201.50.1 PC 10.201.50.2 Is the subnet mask identical? Regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], Thanks for your response. I configured the interface as you suggested, but there's no change. Do you have any other recommendations? Also, is it necessary to set up the Ethernet connection under Tools-Ethernet connection? Regards, [user_name]

After sending a ping to the [product_name], I did not receive a response—so some settings must be incorrect. The [product_name]'s IP only differs from the computer's IP by the last digit, and the gateway is set to the same address as the computer but should probably be different. Any further ideas? Regards, [user_name]

Hi, Please refer to the attached [document]; following its steps should help resolve the issue. The [document] was downloaded from a collection of [product_name] application examples. This might be useful for your next steps. Regards, [user_name]
I'll try these steps tomorrow. Regards, [user_name]

I still can't connect to [product_name] using the associated software. After sending a command via the command prompt, I receive a reply, but the [product_name] status remains 'No'. When attempting to upload a program without a connection, a message appears that new software is needed. My [product_name] firmware version is [version_no]. Regards, [user_name]
Hello [user_name], It's recommended to use the latest version of the software. You can download updates, demo versions, and necessary drivers from the official [url]. Best regards, [user_name]
I was able to connect after some difficulties. Following [user_name]'s instructions and upgrading the [product_name] software solved the problem. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered challenges connecting a PC to a [product_name] device via Ethernet, with problems including unrecognized devices, lack of automatic detection, and incorrect network configurations. Ultimately, updating the [product_name] software resolved the issue, highlighting the importance of compatible software and accurate configuration for successful connectivity.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect easy Ethernet connectivity and dependable device detection between the PC and [product_name], aided by current software versions and clear configuration instructions.
